definition: A technique for improving retrieval by automatically generating additional or reformulated search queries related to the original query.
details: Query expansion can help retrieval systems find relevant documents that use different terminology than the original query, improving recall in both keyword-based and embedding-based search.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Think of it this way: A technique for improving retrieval by automatically generating additional or reformulated search queries related to the original query. And here is the clever part: Query expansion can help retrieval systems find relevant documents that use different terminology than the original query, improving recall in both keyword-based and embedding-based search. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. And that is Query Expansion — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
